entities.name: Elgin Marbles (Parthenon Sculptures)
entities.label: Evidence
entities.summary: A collection of classical Greek marble sculptures, inscriptions, and architectural elements from the Parthenon and other buildings on the Athenian Acropolis, removed by Lord Elgin in 1801-1812 and now in the British Museum. Their study has been fundamental to understanding Athenian art, religion, and society, while their ownership remains one of the most contentious cultural heritage disputes.
